description_en: After public network access is enabled for a bastion host instance, you can add specified public IP addresses to the whitelist to allow public network traffic to access the bastion host instance
description_zh: 堡垒机实例开启公网访问后，可以将指定公网IP地址加入白名单，允许公网流量访问堡垒机实例
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost config-instance-white-list --instance-id bastionhost-cn-78v1gh0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ConfigInstanceWhiteList

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host instance for which you want to configure a public IP address whitelist.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
要配置公网IP地址白名单的堡垒机的实例ID。
可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取堡垒机实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the bastion host instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The IP address whitelist to configure
parameters.help_zh: 需要配置的IP地址白名单
parameters.name: white_list

fields.help_en: The remarks or description of the whitelist rule
fields.help_zh: 对该条白名单规则的备注或描述
fields.name: description

fields.help_en: The IP address whitelist to configure. You can add up to 50 IP addresses. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,). The value cannot contain 0.0.0.0/0
fields.help_zh: 需要配置的 IP 地址白名单。最多支持配置 50 个 IP 地址。如果要将多个 IP 地址加入白名单，多个 IP 之间使用半角逗号（,）隔开。不得包含 0.0.0.0/0
fields.name: entry

parameters.help_en: The IP address whitelist to configure
parameters.help_zh: 需要配置的 IP 地址白名单
parameters.name: white_list_policies

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the bastion host for which the public IP address whitelist is configured
InstanceId.description_zh: 已配置公网IP地址白名单的堡垒机实例ID

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique ID for each request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
